entities.summary: The Donetsk Museum of History and Ethnography is a museum in Donetsk, Rostov Oblast, Russia. It was opened in August 2005. It is devoted to the 50th anniversary of Donetsk. In 1955, It received its modern name in relation to the location on the Seversky Donets River.
